info.description: custom runtime http api, not the stock vendor protocol. bearer authentication is required for every /api/v1 operation. scopes are independent, not hierarchical; x-required-scope names the necessary bit. same-origin requests and configured allowed origins are accepted; a bearer token is still required. the docs and schema endpoints are public and contain no credentials. transport is plaintext on the device. request ids support retries and epoch prevents stale renderer commands.
